newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's internal coffee price up 1.99 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's internal coffee price up 1.99 pct.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 4 Reuter - Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation raised the internal price per 125-kg load of coffee by 1.99 percent to 339,875 pesos, a spokesman said Friday.
The new price, up from 333,250 pesos set Monday, was based on a average international price of $2.02 per pound of coffee in New York.

The federation has now raised the internal price of coffee seven times since Jan. 31. It has been cut twice in the same period since the federation introduced a new sliding scale formula to calculate internal prices based on the average international price.
